title: M405 PORTABLE EXTENDED RANGE vu METER
read: OCR of the technical data sheet; usual OCR slips put right, the rest as read: check against the page

specifications.name: Frequency response
specifications.text: +/-0.25 dB from 20 Hz to 20 kHz. -30 dB down at 60 Hz with filter in.

specifications.name: Noise
specifications.text: Signal to noise ratio better than 50 dB measured from vU meter reading

specifications.name: Total harmonic distortion
specifications.text: Less than 1% from 20 Hz to 20 kHz (measured with any specified input level and at vu output level)

specifications.name: Input impedance
specifications.text: Selectable, 150/600/20K ohms +/-59, unbalanced, floating above ground

specifications.name: Meter ballistics
specifications.text: Complies with ASA vu meter standards.

specifications.name: Power requirements
specifications.text: Self-contained re-chargeable batteries. Line cord supplied to operate from 115V ac and to re-charge cells.

specifications.name: Battery life
specifications.text: More than 40 hrs continuous use. Typically 30 days at hrs. per day intermittent use.
